chapter: Cafe Society and the Zodiac Suite
title: Writing the Zodiac Suite and the WNEW radio show
summary: She began the suite for a WNEW radio programme, one sign a week, and when inspiration ran dry she improvised the rest and recorded it with Nola Studios.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: How did you happen to write the "Zodiac Suite"?

Well, I had started on the "Zodiac Suite" while I was in Cafe Society and I never finished it. I wrote, I think, three. Barney Josephson got me a radio show on WNEW, my own show and I was supposed to introduce one sign a week -Aries, Taurus, and whatnot. I wrote 3 of the signs in the beginning and discovered I was just without ideas. I couldn't write any more, like my inspiration had left me. So what I did to finish them, I went on WNEW and I had Nola Studios to record the program as I played it. So I wrote the rest - I just played them off like that.
What was your radio program like? What kind of a program was it?
Well, I don't know how to describe it but it was just a radio program of not much talk but talk explaining each sign of the zodiac.
The whole thing built around the zodiac?
Yes, and I'd have one guest star. Canada Lee was on one Sunday, and other people. I've forgotten just who they were.
How big a group did you have with you?
